places-friso-de-los-gitanos-o-abrigo-del.story: A 257 km round trip from Nerpio - roughly 4 h 26 in the saddle. It goes by way of Izquierda E. de Santonje, Cueva de la Plata and back through Izquierda E. de Santonje. The highest point is about 1,350 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
